framework.name: NDIS Practice Standards (Core Module)
framework.description: NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission Practice Standards — Core Module. Phase 1 covers 8 representative controls drawn from Standards 1–4 with manual-attestation evaluators. Phase 2 (TODO) requires an NDIS-domain expert to write predicate logic and expand to the full Core + Verification Module indicator set.

domains.name: Rights of Participants and Responsibilities of Providers
domains.description: Standard 1 of the NDIS Practice Standards Core Module.

controls.title: Person-centred supports
controls.summary_description: Each participant accesses supports that respect their culture, diversity, values and beliefs.
controls.implementation_guidance: Document person-centred planning processes; capture participant goals and preferences; review at least every 6 months.
controls.domain: Rights of Participants and Responsibilities of Providers

controls.title: Privacy and dignity
controls.summary_description: Each participant accesses supports that respect and protect their dignity and right to privacy.
controls.implementation_guidance: Privacy policy; staff training on confidentiality; documented information-handling procedures aligned with the Australian Privacy Principles.
controls.domain: Rights of Participants and Responsibilities of Providers

controls.title: Violence, abuse, neglect, exploitation and discrimination
controls.summary_description: Each participant accesses supports free from violence, abuse, neglect, exploitation or discrimination.
controls.implementation_guidance: Safeguarding policy; staff training on identifying and responding to abuse; documented escalation pathway; reportable incident workflow.
controls.domain: Rights of Participants and Responsibilities of Providers

controls.title: Risk management
controls.summary_description: Risks to participants, workers and the provider are identified and managed.
controls.implementation_guidance: Risk register reviewed at least quarterly; treatment plans for residual risks; documented escalation thresholds.

controls.title: Incident management
controls.summary_description: Each participant is safeguarded by the provider's incident-management system.
controls.implementation_guidance: Documented incident-management system; reportable incident workflow that satisfies NDIS Commission notification timeframes; incident register reviewed at least quarterly.

controls.title: Human resource management
controls.summary_description: Workers are competent, hold relevant qualifications, and have the expertise and experience to provide person-centred support.
controls.implementation_guidance: NDIS Worker Screening Check current for every relevant worker; role-specific competency evidence; supervision records.

controls.title: Service agreements with participants
controls.summary_description: Each participant has a clear understanding of the supports they have chosen and how they will be provided.
controls.implementation_guidance: Signed service agreement covering supports, fees, withdrawal rights, complaints process; reviewed when supports change.

controls.title: Safe environment for the delivery of supports
controls.summary_description: Each participant accesses supports in a safe and fit for purpose environment.
controls.implementation_guidance: Environmental risk assessments for service-delivery locations; emergency procedures; equipment maintenance log.
